Name: Rewiring Aotearoa
Description:

Who are we? 

- Philanthropically funded Think-Do Tank
- The world’s first electric cherry farmer, Mike Casey, as CEO
- A group of policy, energy, economic, data, research and storytelling experts
- Aotearoa New Zealand focused
- Fiercely independent

What are we here for? 

- Electrify almost all our fossil fuel machines by 2040
- Fight for the New Zealanders who use the energy system
- Build the cheapest and most renewable energy system in the world
- Create rapid emissions reductions 
- Introduce a new climate narrative

Name: Geoid - digital geography
Description:
Geoid helps people make sense of their place in the world.

We specialise in turning complex spatial data into clean, interactive maps and understanding that inform better decisions; across diverse land use, environment, infrastructure, and climate.

Whether you're advising councils, catchment groups, iwi, or landowners - we support your work with high-quality GIS mapping, spatial analysis, and custom 3D or animated visuals.  From paddock-scale mitigation to catchment planning, our outputs are made to integrate with reports, engage stakeholders, and stand up to scrutiny.

In-house GIS analysis for your business, from my house.  
Linking spatial environmental information with: relevant inherent vulnerability descriptions; real life examples of risks and actions; as well as with practical environmental mitigation strategies. 

If your work relies on location-based data, we make it visible, meaningful, and useful.
Maps that can communicate intricate relationships between different landscapes and provide unique vantage points from which to explore and investigate the world.

Name: Ocean Intelligence
Description:
At Ocean Intelligence, we leverage real-time data to empower marine farmers, enhance productivity, and preserve the health of marine ecosystems.
Our platform combines real-time environmental data with advanced analytics to help you make informed decisions, optimise your operations, and ensure sustainability. Currently, we offer alpha versions of species-specific dashboards for mussels and salmon, with oysters and algae in the works.

Name: Envirolapse
Description:
At Envirolapse, we’re a team of climate-driven technologists, adventurers, and problem-solvers working to make environmental monitoring smarter, more scalable, and more impactful.

We are a deep-tech climate company building real-time environmental monitoring systems for extreme and remote environments — combining AI, ruggedised hardware, and smart data pipelines to improve safety, scientific research, and sustainability outcomes.

Our mission is to deliver real-time, visual environmental insights using advanced camera systems, weather stations, and edge-based data tools—empowering researchers, industries, and frontline decision-makers to act quickly, safely, and responsibly in the face of a rapidly changing planet.

From the glaciers of Antarctica to alpine corridors in Aotearoa and the Canadian Rockies, we design and deploy remote-access systems that monitor avalanche activity, track glacial retreat, support search and rescue, and reduce emissions by replacing the need for high-risk, high-emission field visits.

We believe data should be more than numbers — it should tell stories, save lives, and drive meaningful, real-world impact. That belief powers our vision: to lead a new era of climate visibility and resilience through bold innovation, deep field experience, and a commitment to protecting the world’s wildest places.

Name: Climate Prescience Limited
Description:
About Climate Prescience

Empower your organization with Climate Prescience in our rapidly changing climate. Industries from banking to insurance, and government to finance, face unprecedented risks due to climate change. Billions in assets are at stake, carrying profound financial implications. Climate Prescience serves as the crucial bridge between academic climate science and organizational needs, translating complex data into actionable strategies.

Our Impact

Our expertise has guided risk strategies for entities managing billions in assets, including the largest forest management company in the southern hemisphere. This track record underlines our ability to meet and exceed the TCFD framework's legal reporting requirements, proving our capacity to handle large-scale, high-stakes projects.

Our Services

In-Depth Risk Analysis: We visualize future climate trends and severe weather events, enabling organizations to plan ahead and minimize potential financial exposure.
Bespoke Reporting, Briefing, and Presentation: Our services extend to creating comprehensive reports tailored for sustainability teams and delivering board-level briefing packages that clearly contextualize key findings.
At Climate Prescience, we leverage peer-reviewed frameworks to communicate the uncertainty and variability inherent in climate projection work—a unique strength in our industry. Entrust your future to us; together, we can navigate the risk-exposed world, securing your future in a changing climate.
Location: Rotorua, Bay of Plenty, New Zealand

Name: International Association for Carbon Minus
Description:
International Association for Carbon Minus (IACM) is a global initiative headquartered in Aotearoa New Zealand, one of the world’s most sustainability-driven nations.
Rooted in the values of kaitiakitanga (guardianship of the environment) and whanaungatanga (community and collective responsibility), we go beyond carbon neutrality to set the benchmark for Net Negative carbon performance. Our standards are designed to be rigorous, transparent, and assurance-ready, reflecting both global best practice and Aotearoa’s unique sustainability ethos.
As a forward-looking organisation, we not only certify and benchmark ESG performance but also actively foster partnerships across governments, corporates, investors, and communities. Through collaboration and innovation, we drive the global transition towards a fair, regenerative, and truly sustainable future.
